rs3745274: CYP2B6 rs3745274 TT is associated with increased plasma efavirenz concentration during efavirenz treatment with rifampicin as compared to CYP2B6 rs3745274 GT or GG.
CYP2B6 rs3745274 TT is associated with increased plasma nevirapine concentration during nevirapine treatment with rifampicin as compared to CYP2B6 rs3745274 GT or GG.

CYP2B6 rs3745274 TT is not associated with increased likelihood of achieving HIV-1 RNA levels less than 50 copies/mL at week 12 during efavirenz treatment with rifampicin as compared to CYP2B6 rs3745274 GT or GG.

CYP2B6 rs3745274 TT is not associated with increased likelihood of achieving HIV-1 RNA levels less than 50 copies/mL at week 12 during nevirapine treatment with rifampicin as compared to CYP2B6 rs3745274 GT or GG.
CYP2B6 rs3745274 genotype is not associated with CD4 T-cell count response during efavirenz treatment with rifampicin.
CYP2B6 rs3745274 genotype is not associated with CD4 T-cell count response during nevirapine treatment with rifampicin.
